method: Trailing-window in-scope arXiv records (analysis/classified.jsonl), grouped by primary_cluster, ids sorted, EXCLUDING the 330 ids in analysis/precision_audit_v2.json; one random.Random(2026) instance, rng.sample(ids,10) per cluster in precision_audit_v2.json cluster order. Title+abstract read; strict rule: correct only if the paper's main subject is the cluster topic (methods papers correct when the cluster physics is the stated application; residual clusters judged against their own broad label). Single annotator (auditor lane q1-precision).
